title: Agent Identity signup receipt claims (agent-signup-receipt+jwt)
description: Contract E (v1.2) claims. The receipt typ stays `agent-signup-receipt+jwt`; v1.2 changes the claims, not the typ. Signed by the RP key named in `service.key_id`, which MUST be present in the attestation named by `service.attestation_jti` with `receipt` in its purposes. No `exp`: a receipt is a historical fact, valid when `iat` and `signed_up_at` both fall inside the attestation's [iat, exp] window, even when ingested later. A legacy `exp`, if present, is ignored. Header `kid` MUST equal `service.key_id`. Cross-field rules (key membership, window, origin equality, header kid) are normative in agent-identity-v1.md §11 and enforced by Contract F.

iss.description: RP origin. MUST equal `service.origin` and the attestation `rp.origin`.

sub.description: Agent id. MUST equal the acceptance agent id.

jti.description: Receipt id: `srp_` + 26-character lowercase Crockford base32 ULID. Unique forever.

iat.description: Receipt signing time (integer seconds). MUST fall inside the attestation [iat, exp] window.

signed_up_at.description: When the signup happened (integer seconds). MUST fall inside the attestation [iat, exp] window.

exp.description: DEPRECATED. A legacy expiry is ignored and never causes rejection. v1.2 producers MUST NOT emit it.

assertion_jti.description: The `jti` of the assertion presented at signup.

provider_url.description: OPTIONAL display/context hint. Not an identity binding.

account_id.description: Opaque vendor account reference; not a resource inventory.

attestation_jti.description: The attestation that contained `key_id` at signing time. Contract F verifies this exact attestation in historical mode.

key_id.description: The RP key that signed this receipt. MUST be in the attestation `keys[]` with `receipt` in purposes; MUST equal the JWS header `kid`.

context.description: Optional post-signup context guide pointer (spec §11). Not part of the attestation.
